title: HtmlLi
responsibility: Renders the native li element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlLi.attributes
inputs.description: Native li attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlLi.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native li element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlLi
outputs.description: The actual native li element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
